business: Wendlow Fabrication & Machine (simulated job shop), 2016-2025, run 9
source: pathmode-corpus simulations/fabricator/grading/truth-summary.md, BUILD.md (runs 8 and 9) and the truth database (schema truth in the grader's database)

problems.name: Slow quotes losing work
problems.mechanism: Quotes sent late win far less often (within 2 working days about 34%, 5+ days about 18%). Since runs 8-9 the delay comes mostly from how requests are handled: the quotes inbox is read and keyed twice a week, and about 40% of new requests are missing a revision, quantity or drawing, found only when an estimator opens the request to price it, after which it waits for the buyer's answer. The two estimator vacancies (2021-04, 2024-03) add to it.
problems.shows_in: rfqs (received_on, entered_on), quotes (sent dates, outcomes), the mail log
problems.truth: about 237 new requests a year (20%) lost because the quote came after the buyer decided (2023-25)

problems.name: Estimates that drift on some families
problems.mechanism: Welding on families 3 and 4 runs about 1.03-1.07x the shop standard and about 1.2-1.4x each estimator's estimate; precision machining (family 5) runs under. The re-quotes copy the old estimates forward.
problems.shows_in: quote line estimated hours by work centre against labour clock-ins by job and operation
problems.truth: weld true/estimated about 1.22-1.44 on families 3-4 for every estimator; family 5 about 0.86-0.96

problems.name: Due dates promised without a capacity check
problems.mechanism: Due dates are promised from a standard lead time; when the bottleneck work centre (laser and brake in 2016 and 2019-21, weld from 2022) is loaded, lines go late.
problems.shows_in: sales order promised dates against shipments, and labour by work centre
problems.truth: on time 78% (welding lines) in 2016 and 76-83% in 2021, against 93-99% in other years

problems.name: Material increases eaten between quote and purchase
problems.mechanism: Steel bought after the quote at higher prices; repeat orders keep the old price; the surcharge clause recovers little.
problems.shows_in: quote material cost against purchase-order cost by order, with the steel price index
problems.truth: $3,029,316 of material over quote in 2021 (by year bought), $769,433 in 2018; 2019-20 and 2023-24 under

problems.name: Engineering changes that don't reach the floor
problems.mechanism: A revision arrives by email that names no job, after the traveller is printed, or while engineering is behind; the job is built to the old revision; some escape to the customer as returns.
problems.shows_in: drawing revisions, ECOs and the jobs logged against them, scrap reports, inspections, returns
problems.truth: 305 jobs built to an old revision (170 email named no job, 91 traveller already printed, 44 engineering behind); 81 escaped to the customer

problems.name: Know-how in one or two people
problems.mechanism: The senior CAM programmer left in 2022 (programs and first articles suffer: first-article failures roughly doubled); the senior estimator's departure in 2024 slowed quotes.
problems.shows_in: CAM programs by author, inspections (first articles), quote turnaround by period
problems.truth: senior programmer wrote 64-108 programs a year through 2021, 59 in 2022, none after
